modes.modes.actions.body: Preview, request and result receipts are signed. Before a button press, the server fetches the message again and rejects a changed keyboard. Returned callback text and URLs remain recorded context.
modes.modes.actions.intro: Send or reply, press a current bot button, save a link preview, then explicitly join a chat or start a bot with its start parameter.
modes.modes.actions.no: No web apps, payments, phone/location sharing or inline queries. Displaying a URL does not open it.
modes.modes.actions.title: Act from the panel
modes.modes.api.body: Your own API pair is optional. Without one, TgWitness uses a pool of public pairs, including pairs from official Telegram Desktop.
modes.modes.api.title: API pair
modes.modes.compare.intro: Basic artifacts without added signing, timestamp or witness systems. Scripts and loggers vary by implementation; “partial” means limited to captured or visible material.
modes.modes.compare.no: The table does not assess every script or logging product. Optional time and witness checks require their own services and trust anchors; none establishes source truth.
modes.modes.compare.title: Compare the delivered artifact
modes.modes.connection.independence: Two workspaces on one machine are not two independent witnesses.
modes.modes.connection.intro: Each account has its own workspace, journal, signing key, route and queue.
modes.modes.connection.no: Import does not bypass Telegram authorization, 2FA or unsupported session formats. Accounts still share the application process.
modes.modes.connection.routes: MTProxy is experimental; built-in public MTProxy lists are available. A failed proxy route does not fall back to a direct connection.
modes.modes.connection.title: Use the authorization you have
modes.modes.continuity.coverage.body: Observation periods, gaps with reasons and unobserved IDs accompany the signed export. A missing-on-recheck record is not a deletion notice.
modes.modes.continuity.no: A later history snapshot does not erase an outage or recover every vanished version. The saved cursor is not a lossless acknowledgement of journal acceptance.
modes.modes.continuity.recheck.body: Defaults: priority sources every 15 minutes, others every 6 hours. Outcomes include message.recovered and message.missing_on_recheck.
modes.modes.continuity.restart.body: After restart, Telegram is asked for missed updates. Finite retention and expired differences can leave gaps.
modes.modes.continuity.title: Recovery and continuity
modes.modes.event.attachment.saved: Original-version descriptor, saved bytes, SHA-256 and attempt outcomes.
modes.modes.event.attachment.unknown: A vanished file may be unavailable; a newer version does not replace it.
modes.modes.event.buttons.saved: Callback, URL, web-app and request metadata retained with the message.
modes.modes.event.buttons.unknown: URLs and phone/location requests are text, not automatically opened or executed.
modes.modes.event.deletion.saved: Notice plus previously saved text, if available.
modes.modes.event.deletion.unknown: The deleter and exact action time are not supplied.
modes.modes.event.edit.saved: Every observed version, without overwriting earlier ones.
modes.modes.event.edit.unknown: Intermediate edits may be missed; sender is not necessarily editor.
modes.modes.event.history.saved: Currently visible messages, marked as history observations.
modes.modes.event.history.unknown: Earlier edits and vanished content are not reconstructed.
modes.modes.event.membership.saved: Delivered service messages and participant updates.
modes.modes.event.membership.unknown: Role and chat type limit visibility; silence does not establish absence.
modes.modes.event.message.saved: Text, IDs, sender metadata, reply context and original update envelope.
modes.modes.event.own.saved: Outgoing messages/edits and matching reply-keyboard button_press metadata.
modes.modes.event.own.unknown: Callbacks pressed in another Telegram client are not visible.
modes.modes.event.reaction.saved: Delivered counters and visible recent identities.
modes.modes.event.reaction.unknown: Not every reactor is visible; a full available list needs separate queries.
modes.modes.event.unscoped.saved: Account-level notice; unknown peer remains explicit.
modes.modes.event.unscoped.unknown: No guessed chat. Correlation uses previously saved account-scoped IDs when possible.
modes.modes.events.intro: Only delivered or explicitly requested observations enter the record. Unknown attribution stays unknown.
modes.modes.events.matrix: Event matrix: saved material and remaining unknowns
modes.modes.events.no: A switch does not redact embedded metadata or disable operational records. Capture does not identify an actor whom Telegram did not supply.
modes.modes.events.policy: The panel applies these switches per workspace. Turning one off keeps existing records; turning it back on does not reconstruct missed events.
modes.modes.events.title: What is recorded
modes.modes.export.intro: Supply the signed original, an independently retained key fingerprint, the relevant checkpoint and the verification result.
modes.modes.export.no: Standalone CSV and HTML are not signed containers. A password protects transfer confidentiality, not authenticity. Multiple exports do not merge account journals.
modes.modes.export.title: Hand over a checkable package
modes.modes.export.trust: Obtain the verifier from a trusted copy, not from the archive being checked.
modes.modes.flow.caption: Integrity is checked. Telegram origin and the truth of a message remain separate questions.
modes.modes.footer: This guide ships with the application. No external scripts, fonts or analytics.
modes.modes.hash.changed: Record 2 changed. Its hash no longer matches the saved hash or the link retained by record 3.
modes.modes.hash.intro: The next record keeps the previously saved link. Changing the text changes record 2’s calculated hash.
modes.modes.hash.label: Text of record 2
modes.modes.hash.limit: This sample calculates hashes, not signatures. The real verifier checks every signature and link against the trusted key.
modes.modes.hash.ok: The calculated hash matches the saved hash. The three links agree.
modes.modes.hash.static: Static example: h2 covers “Meet at 11:00”. Changing that text changes h2; record 3 still references the saved h2.
modes.modes.hash.title: Try changing record 2
modes.modes.hash.unavailable: Interactive hashing is unavailable. The static explanation remains readable.
modes.modes.intro: TgWitness records what the connected account observes. A third party can verify the record’s integrity against an independently trusted key.
modes.modes.level.boundary.mechanism: Checkpoint at startup, every 5 minutes by default, and orderly stop. Keep a copy elsewhere.
modes.modes.level.boundary.no: It does not detect replacement of both journal and all retained checkpoints.
modes.modes.level.boundary.proves: The later export agrees with an earlier retained length and head; rollback can be detected.
modes.modes.level.container.mechanism: manifest.json lists file hashes; manifest.sig signs it. media.saved binds attachment bytes to an event.
modes.modes.level.container.no: It does not sign a separately downloaded CSV, HTML or screenshot.
modes.modes.level.container.proves: The supplied files agree with the signed manifest and media receipts.
modes.modes.level.proof.mechanism: Public multi-account counters without message content and signed JSON.
modes.modes.level.proof.no: It does not prove delivery of every Telegram update or trust the displayed counters without recounting.
modes.modes.level.proof.proves: With the evidence ZIP, the verifier checks the retained prefix and recomputes the counters.
modes.modes.level.provenance.mechanism: Signed run receipt: source hashes, dependency versions and process context. Self-reported.
modes.modes.level.provenance.no: It does not provide independent process attestation or exclude compromise before recording.
modes.modes.level.provenance.proves: What the signing collector reported about its own execution.
modes.modes.level.record.mechanism: SHA-256 chain + Ed25519 per event; the first previous_hash is 64 zeroes.
modes.modes.level.record.no: It does not prove Telegram origin or completeness.
modes.modes.level.record.proves: Ordering and signatures under the pinned collector key.
modes.modes.level.replica.mechanism: S3-compatible copy encrypted with AES-256-GCM; Object Lock when the bucket supports it.
modes.modes.level.replica.no: It does not restore without the exported key or assume retention without checking the storage response.
modes.modes.level.replica.proves: Restore publishes files only after journal, checkpoint and preserved-media verification succeeds.
modes.modes.level.time.mechanism: Evidence mode sends a checkpoint SHA-256 to RFC 3161 authorities (FreeTSA, DigiCert) and OpenTimestamps calendars.
modes.modes.level.time.no: It does not treat a prepared request or pending calendar receipt as a confirmed timestamp.
modes.modes.level.time.proves: A verified TSA response dates those bytes; a confirmed OpenTimestamps proof anchors them to Bitcoin.
modes.modes.level.witness.mechanism: Separate host, scoped read-only endpoint, fresh challenge, its own key/journal and TGW1 channel posts.
modes.modes.level.witness.no: It does not turn two workspaces on one collector host into independent witnesses.
modes.modes.level.witness.proves: Earlier accepted heads; statuses ok, key_changed, rollback, fork, invalid and no_response.
modes.modes.levels.boundary.body: Delivery of every Telegram update; the truth of the text; that a sender ID identifies a real person; absence of collector compromise before recording; admissibility in court.
modes.modes.levels.intro: Each mechanism answers a bounded question. Configure external services separately and retain their trust anchors outside the collector.
modes.modes.levels.title: Eight levels. Different questions.
modes.modes.limits.account: Use a dedicated account, not your primary account.
modes.modes.limits.intro: Verification is useful when its scope stays explicit.
modes.modes.limits.no: No mode or evidence level establishes legal admissibility, complete Telegram delivery or real-world identity.
modes.modes.limits.offline: Nothing is recorded while the process is stopped; recovery is bounded.
modes.modes.limits.operator: An operator with the key can sign arbitrary content. Independent witnesses and timestamps constrain later replacement, not dishonest initial capture.
modes.modes.limits.telegram: Telegram can restrict accounts for request volume.
modes.modes.limits.title: Keep the limits with the evidence
modes.modes.limits.truth: A verified record is not proof that its content is true.
modes.modes.linkedEnglish: This page and the setup guides are translated. Detailed reference pages are currently in English.
modes.modes.login.hex.body: Import account authorization with its data-center identifier.
modes.modes.login.json.body: Select the session and matching companion metadata.
modes.modes.login.pyrogram.body: Import the supported Pyrogram session format.
modes.modes.login.qr.body: Scan from an authorized device; 2FA may still be required.
modes.modes.login.tdata.body: One supported Desktop account; local passcode if set.
modes.modes.media.title: Default attachment limits
modes.modes.readtime: 3–5 minute overview · fictional examples · current implementation
modes.modes.scenario.bot.check: Signed ZIP; verify any dossier against the ZIP.
modes.modes.scenario.bot.mode: Investigation preset → buttons, link previews and explicit bot start.
modes.modes.scenario.bot.no: It does not open a bot web app, make a payment or record another client’s callbacks.
modes.modes.scenario.bot.output: Signed interaction receipts, returned callbacks and saved profiles.
modes.modes.scenario.identity: A participant changes names across chats
modes.modes.scenario.identity.check: Dossier JSON checked against the signed ZIP.
modes.modes.scenario.identity.no: It does not turn a wallet, phone-like string or username into proven identity.
modes.modes.scenario.identity.output: Name/username history by numeric ID, “also in” links and extracted leads.
modes.modes.scenario.incident.mode: Folder or whole account → all event categories.
modes.modes.scenario.incident.no: It does not identify the deleter from a notice that supplies no actor.
modes.modes.scenario.incident.output: Saved originals, deletion notices and coverage with gaps.
modes.modes.scenario.long: Long-running observation with an off-site copy
modes.modes.scenario.long.check: Restore with the exported key, then verify without the original server.
modes.modes.scenario.long.mode: Any scope → Evidence mode and an S3 replica with supported Object Lock.
modes.modes.scenario.long.no: It does not replace an independent witness or a separately retained decryption key.
modes.modes.scenario.long.output: Encrypted copy, retained checkpoints and timestamp responses.
modes.modes.scenario.pilot.mode: Three workspaces → Proof monitor and an independent send/edit/delete canary with a nonce.
modes.modes.scenario.pilot.no: It does not treat this proposed pilot as an already completed live test.
modes.modes.scenario.pilot.output: Signed proof JSON and controlled capture results.
modes.modes.scenario.scam.check: Signed ZIP + retained checkpoint + verified TSA response.
modes.modes.scenario.scam.no: It does not recover an original that was never captured.
modes.modes.scenario.scam.output: Observed post versions and attachments by hash.
modes.modes.scenarios.intro: Fictional situations. Start collection before the relevant event; preserve the boundaries and gaps alongside the content.
modes.modes.scenarios.title: Choose a route through the evidence
modes.modes.scope.chosen.name: Chosen chats
modes.modes.scope.chosen.no: It does not discover other chats or backfill earlier history.
modes.modes.scope.chosen.use: A known set of channels or groups. No fixed chat capacity has been qualified.
modes.modes.scope.example: These cards are a local comparison, not live collector controls. They do not change an account.
modes.modes.scope.folder.name: Telegram folder
modes.modes.scope.folder.new: Matching active chats; folder changes within an hour.
modes.modes.scope.folder.no: It does not apply the folder’s changing muted/read conditions.
modes.modes.scope.folder.records: Folder inclusions and categories, minus exclusions and archived chats when configured.
modes.modes.scope.folder.use: An analyst already maintains a case folder. Confirm collection on a dedicated account.
modes.modes.scope.intro: Three scopes and an investigation preset. Exclusions and enabled source types still apply.
modes.modes.scope.investigation.name: Investigation mode
modes.modes.scope.investigation.new: A new chat or bot gets a profile and a history snapshot.
modes.modes.scope.investigation.no: It does not snapshot every existing chat or observe callbacks pressed in another client.
modes.modes.scope.investigation.records: All source types, own actions, source profiles and the latest 200 visible messages of newly discovered sources.
modes.modes.scope.investigation.use: Join a team or interact with a bot through the panel. Review and save the preset.
modes.modes.scope.no: No mode reads secret chats, records while the process is stopped, joins sources on its own or retrieves earlier history beyond a requested snapshot/export.
modes.modes.scope.title: Choose the observation scope
modes.modes.scope.whole.name: Whole account
modes.modes.scope.whole.new: Added when the first update arrives.
modes.modes.scope.whole.no: It does not join chats automatically or bypass source access.
modes.modes.scope.whole.records: Account-visible chats, including private conversations and bots, within selected types.
modes.modes.scope.whole.use: A dedicated observation account, including an account participating in a case.
modes.modes.seo: Collection scopes, event boundaries, eight verification mechanisms and six fictional investigation scenarios.
modes.modes.theme: Switch between light and dark theme
modes.modes.title: One journal. Four collection modes. Eight verification levels.
